protocol.protocol_kind: Frozen method matrix before extension result inspection; not a public preregistration

data.fit: Original published experience: one jump example and 64 old commands
data.select: Published V_check: 2569 new commands and old_check: 1000 old commands
data.final: Published sealed split: 2568 new and 1000 old commands
data.scope: This is a re-execution and mechanistic analysis on the published held-out split, not a newly collected independent holdout or evidence about HeptaTrader
data.information_asymmetry: The published program additionally uses the known SCAN grammar and unlabeled forward probes. Gradient baselines below fit the same original 65 labeled experience rows. Report this asymmetry; do not call the full information budget identical.

random_controls.recipe: Independent Gaussian delta on exactly the published nonzero edit support, normalized to the published edit L2 norm separately for each tensor; no tuning or selection

gradient_baselines.selection_rule: Discard any candidate with old_check fixed-minus-broken below -5; maximize new_check fixed-minus-broken plus old_check fixed-minus-broken; keep original when no positive candidate qualifies; ties prefer the first candidate in the fixed upstream order
gradient_baselines.final_evaluation: Evaluate only the selected checkpoint of each method and seed once on the published sealed set

quality: new gain plus old change in percentage points
cost: sample-forward equivalents for monitored forward calls
measurement.uncertainty: Report all seeds. Paired-bootstrap intervals use 2000 fixed-seed resamples of per-command correctness differences; they quantify command sampling, not unobserved model-training variation.
measurement.rollback: Restore the original stored array bytes, then verify the complete canonical parameter SHA; do not infer byte-exact rollback from subtracting rounded deltas.

protocol.stopping: Run this fixed matrix once; no hyperparameter revisions based on final scores. A harness failure can be fixed only with a documented non-method change and the same protocol.

interpretation: Published heldout reexecution; no claim of fresh independent test or Hepta endpoint improvement.
cost_definition: Rows are sample-forward counts, not FLOPs. Gradient forward rows are also counted in all torch forward rows; backward ~2x forward is an approximate separate conversion. Exact-hash prediction caches reduce actual executed checks; logical candidate check counts remain eight.
